summary: Belden Inc. filed an 8-K to announce a definitive Purchase Agreement to acquire the RUCKUS reporting segment of Vistance Networks for ~$1.846B in cash on a cash-free, debt-free basis. The transaction will be financed through cash on hand and committed debt financing. Closing conditions include HSR antitrust clearance and regulatory approvals in other jurisdictions, with no break fee mentioned. The closing is expected in the second half of 2026. Watch for regulatory clearance timelines and potential financing updates; the all-cash structure simplifies the risk-arb spread.
